scope: Descriptive source comparison and provisional image review; no expert gold, training or new OCR

VT.lineage: Takahashi via Voynichese; NOT independent of IT

ZL.lineage: Distinct Zandbergen-Landini reading; shared images/alphabet/editorial conventions, not statistical independence

pairing: Exact external folio and locus number; preserve missing loci and incompatible locus types. No OCR-based pairing.
parser: Preserve raw strings and all inline nodes. Keep drawing separators <->/<~>, uncertain comma, ligature marks, alternatives and unreadables. Main edit alignment restricted to literal lowercase basic EVA after case projection and ligature-bracket removal with raw text retained; exclude alternatives/rare/unknown rather than choose a preferred reading.
alignment: Unit-cost letter Levenshtein within matched locus, separate from boundaries. Preserve ALL vertices on any minimum-cost path using forward+backward distance; no arbitrary best-path word alignment and no probabilities inferred from counts.
spatial_bridge: Map original XML tokens to VT loci only if full-folio token sequences are identical after documented separators. Otherwise mark entire folio unmapped; no shift or fuzzy join.
geometry: Recompute original raster masks on 989 accepted word crops; quantify shared dark pixels with median-gray minus40 as diagnostic, not ownership of ink. Keep original images and labels unchanged.
review_selection: Training rows only: up to8 source disagreement/ambiguous associations ordered by ID;8 highest shared-dark fractions thenID excluding selected;8 lowest shared-dark fractions thenID excluding selected. Never rank by OCR prediction/error; retain held-out roles unchanged.
visual_review: Generate24context panels max with frozen masked crop, unmasked original rectangle, larger photograph context and neighboring polygons. Assistant observations and independent expert review are separate fields. No label/geometry approved automatically.
Boxer: Retain provenance and native row tokens for4folios as contextual third reading; no undocumented Boxer-to-EVA conversion and no character-level agreement score.
success_criterion: Integrity/replay of source comparison and review artifacts. Descriptive counts only, no hypothesis significance or OCR improvement claim.
